purpose: Validate Qwen3-4B QLoRA feasibility, target-token arm construction, and Stage-C isolation before development effect estimation.

arm_contract.matched_budget_rule: minimum available target-token count across curated, common Stage-A random, and raw-random candidates, capped at smoke_max_tokens
arm_contract.common_stage_a_baseline: The frozen selected-disjoint Stage-A-random arm is reused unchanged for every sensitivity comparison.

smoke_success_criteria: target-token arms are constructed and SHA-256 frozen
curated and common Stage-A-random are disjoint
the same common Stage-A baseline identity is referenced by every sensitivity arm
Qwen3-4B loads in 4-bit and completes at least one optimizer step
all requested arms use matched token and optimizer-step budgets
development and confirmatory records are never read by Stage B
development_entry_rule: Freeze practical effect margin, development seeds, evaluation tasks, and retention guardrails after smoke feasibility and before development outcomes.
utility_scope: Stage C validation only; never selector objective
human_or_llm_review: optional diagnostic only; never ground truth, tuning signal, or entry gate
